Enums, interfaces and schemas; canonical definitions and review evidence.

Canonical enums, interfaces and schemas, with explicit ownership, reusable definitions and source evidence.

Reviewed content version: 2.3.0-design. Registry format: 2.

Fully Defined means the documentation contract is complete within its stated responsibility. Needs Decision identifies a partial contract with a recorded unresolved question. Neither status certifies runtime behavior or game balance. Existing/Proposed records provenance separately from completeness.

Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints

selection TargetSelection Required Selection.
reservation_ids set of Id Required Reservation ids.

CharacterState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Character state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
entity_id Id Required Entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
session SessionAuthority Required Session.
movement MovementState Required Movement.
life_state CharacterLifeState Required Life state.
build_version Version Required Build version.
stats DerivedCombatStats Required Stats.
health CombatAmount Required Health.
resources ID-keyed map of ResourcePoolState Required Resources.
cooldowns ID-keyed map of CooldownState Required Cooldowns.
statuses ID-keyed map of StatusInstance Required Statuses.
cast CastState | null Required Cast.
summon_capacity SummonCapacityState Required Summon capacity.
damage_ledger DamageLedger Required Damage ledger.
talent_procs ID-keyed map of TalentProcState Required Trigger ID to this character’s canonical proc state; empty when no selected proc is enabled.

DuelState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Duel state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
duel_id Id Required Duel id.
participant_character_ids set of Id Required Participant character ids. {"minItems": 2, "maxItems": 2}
consenting_character_ids set of Id Required Consenting character ids.
active boolean Required Active.
phase string Required Explicit duel lifecycle; active boolean is its derived projection. {"enum": ["offered", "active", "completed", "cancelled"]}
ruleset_id Id Required Selected duel ruleset. Reference: PvpRulesetDefinition (content).
center WorldPoint | null Required Null before both participants accept.
winner_character_id Id | null Required Null until a win or for a cancelled/drawn duel.
end_reason string | null Required Null before termination.
started_at Instant | null Required Null while offered.
deadline_at Instant Required Current offer expiry or active time-limit deadline.
  • Exactly two distinct participants; consenting IDs are their subset. offered becomes active only when both consent and server location/protection checks pass. active boolean equals phase==active and cannot authorize a second lifecycle.
  • Defeat clamps the losing player to one health without PvE death/durability loss, and completes the duel once. Surrender or exceeding boundary grace forfeits. A participant still disconnected when the existing disconnect grace expires forfeits; reconnect within grace resumes the same duel.
  • The time limit with no defeat is a draw. Invalid scope/protection cancels. No competitive rewards or cooldown/resource/debt reset are generated by a duel result. Ordinary third-party hostility cannot be authorized by duel consent.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

EquipmentSet Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Equipment set.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
equipment_set_id Id Required Equipment set id. Reference: EquipmentSet (instance).
slots array of EquipmentSlotAssignment Required Slots.
owner_character_id Id Required Owner of the personal equipment container and slot assignments. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
version Version Required Equipment revision checked by equip and unequip transactions.
  • At most one assignment per slot. Two-handed equipment occupies both main_hand/off_hand using the same instance ID; no duplicate budget. Bag/tool utility slots are separate.
  • Equipping moves an instance from its bag into the personal equipment container. ItemOwnershipRecord owns placement; slots describe use of those same instances. All ownership, container membership and slot changes commit atomically.
  • Two-handed weapons reserve main_hand and off_hand together. Replacing equipment requires valid bag destinations for displaced items; full bags reject the entire operation. Equipped stacks have quantity one.
  • Displaced equipment returns to the incoming item source bag in stable EquipmentSlot order, using its freed capacity. Reserve space for every displaced instance before committing; no implicit mail, bank or delivery fallback.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

GuildInvitation Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Guild invitation.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
invitation_id Id Required Invitation id.
guild_id Id Required Guild id. Reference: GuildRecord (instance).
inviter_character_id Id Required Inviter character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
recipient_character_id Id Required Recipient character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
created_at Instant Required Authoritative creation time.
expires_at Instant Required Required configured expiry; no implicit duration.
state InvitationState Required Current invitation lifecycle state.
version Version Required Optimistic version checked when responding.
  • Only pending invitations can be accepted, declined or revoked. Expiry is checked using authoritative time even if an expiry job has not run; expires_at must be later than created_at.
  • Only the recipient may accept or decline; only an authorized inviter/leader may revoke. Recheck membership, capacity, permissions and encounter locks at acceptance. Revoked, expired or stale invitations never change membership.
  • Accept commits membership and terminal invitation state atomically. Idempotent retries return the original result without adding membership or consuming limits twice. Expiry duration is required service configuration.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

ItemInstance Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Item instance.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
item_id Id Required Item id. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).
definition_id Id Required Definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
quantity integer Required Quantity. {"minimum": 1}
ownership ItemOwnershipRecord Required Ownership.
binding ItemBindingState Required Binding.
durability_percent Percent | null Required Durability percent.
grade ItemGrade Required Grade.
version Version Required Version.
enhancements array of EnhancementInstance Required Enhancements.
  • Globally unique item_id; quantity > 0 for an extant instance. Durability is null for non-durable items.
  • Definition, binding, grade and all stack-relevant attributes must match before merging. Ownership is one canonical record; consumer views reference this instance.
  • Equipped instances have quantity one and canonical equipment-container ownership; equipment views do not embed another mutable instance.
  • Stack-relevant attributes include immutable CraftMaterialProvenance. Durable lineage owns that basis; ItemInstance is a view, not a second writable provenance copy. Trade/split/merge retain per-unit entitlement and inherited starter export restrictions.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • Runtime ItemInstance is an authorized view of durable instance/ownership state, not a second writable inventory. grade derives from current definition; binding records the current instance transition, not initial blueprint policy.
  • Instance version and ownership version identify the same atomic revision; intentionally retained for optimistic ownership validation.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

LootRoll Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Loot roll.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
roll_id Id Required Roll id.
reservation_id Id Required Reservation id.
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
choice_id string Required Equal-priority shared-drop choice; no implicit need/greed priority. {"enum": ["claim", "pass"]}
submitted_at Instant Required Authoritative submission time checked against the reservation deadline.
  • One final claim/pass choice per eligible character and reservation, validated against the frozen eligibility snapshot and server deadline. Missing choice at deadline is pass; the client never supplies a random roll.
  • At deadline, uniformly shuffle the stable set of eligible claimants once on the server and persist the resulting order. First claimant wins; the persisted permutation settles all tie order without a second client-facing numeric roll.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

MatchState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Match state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
match_id Id Required Match id.
ruleset_id Id Required Ruleset id. Reference: PvpRulesetDefinition (content).
phase MatchPhase Required Phase.
teams ID-keyed map of IdList Required Teams.
scores ID-keyed map of Count Required Score map keyed by the two accepted team IDs.
objective_owner_team_id Id | null Required Null for neutral objective.
objective_contested boolean Required Derived presence conflict; server alone evaluates capture/scoring.
started_at Instant | null Required Null before activation.
ends_at Instant | null Required Null before activation.
capture_progress_seconds ID-keyed map of Seconds Required Server capture progress keyed by the two accepted team IDs.
last_objective_update_at Instant Required Last authoritative capture/scoring update.
  • Instanced objective teams are equal size. Phase/objective/scoring rules require authored policy.
  • preparing transitions to active only after the selected ruleset and teams validate. active transitions to completed through an authored end condition; preparing or active may transition to cancelled. Terminal phases never restart or grant rewards twice.
  • scores and capture_progress_seconds contain exactly the accepted team IDs. Active matches have started_at/ends_at; server elapsed time alone advances progress and scoring. Clients cannot submit score, capture progress or objective ownership.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

  • Server owns kit execution and threat. NPC definitions are content, not persistent player character records.
  • Alive idle enters engaged only on a legal perceived hostile root event. Losing all eligible targets or exceeding the configured leash bounds enters leashing. Leashing rejects combat actions, clears threat and encounter-owned hazards, and returns to home before restoring maximum health and idle. Health zero enters dead; death resolves its completion key once.

Inspect canonical definition

Participation credit.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints

effective_healing CombatAmount Required Effective healing.
absorbs_consumed CombatAmount Required Absorbs consumed.
tanking_credit CombatAmount Required Tanking credit.
support_credit CombatAmount Required Support credit.
eligible boolean Required Eligible.
  • Eligibility also requires encounter bounds, membership and valid engagement; damage alone does not determine rewards.
  • Eligible participation requires membership in the engagement snapshot, presence inside encounter bounds, and a nonzero effective damage/heal/consumed-prevention/tanking/support contribution before completion. Late joins qualify for subsequent encounters. Self-harm, friendly summon attacks, overhealing and overkill are excluded.
  • Qualifying support/healing must benefit an eligible engaged member. Summon output is assigned once to its owner. A personal reward is granted at most once per completion key irrespective of role or contribution magnitude.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

PartyInvitation Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Party invitation.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
invitation_id Id Required Invitation id.
party_id Id Required Party id. Reference: PartyState (instance).
inviter_character_id Id Required Inviter character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
recipient_character_id Id Required Recipient character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
created_at Instant Required Authoritative creation time.
expires_at Instant Required Required configured expiry; no implicit duration.
state InvitationState Required Current invitation lifecycle state.
version Version Required Optimistic version checked when responding.
  • Only pending invitations can be accepted, declined or revoked. Expiry is checked using authoritative time even if an expiry job has not run; expires_at must be later than created_at.
  • Only the recipient may accept or decline; only an authorized inviter/leader may revoke. Recheck membership, capacity, permissions and encounter locks at acceptance. Revoked, expired or stale invitations never change membership.
  • Accept commits membership and terminal invitation state atomically. Idempotent retries return the original result without adding membership or consuming limits twice. Expiry duration is required service configuration.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

ProjectileState Existing · Fully Defined

Projectile state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
entity_id Id Required Entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
definition_id Id Required Definition id.
action_id Id Required Action id.
owner_entity_id Id Required Owner entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
location WorldPoint Required Location.
direction Vector2 Required Direction.
speed_units_per_second CombatAmount Required Speed units per second.
expires_at Instant Required Expires at.
hit_policy ProjectileHitPolicy Required Hit policy.
collision_policy ProjectileCollisionPolicy Required Collision policy.
collision_mask "solid_world" Required Semantic world-obstruction mask, resolved by the server to its engine collision layers; clients cannot supply a mask. {"const": "solid_world"}
target_entity_id Id | null Required Target entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
hit_entity_ids set of Id Required Hit entity ids.
target_cap integer Required Target cap. {"minimum": 1}
homing boolean Required Whether the declared trajectory follows its locked eligible target; false uses original direction.
  • Swept server collision; retain hit entity set for piercing, finite target count; validate relation and existence at homing impact.
  • stop_on_world uses solid_world geometry, closed doors and floor boundaries. Piercing can continue through eligible actors up to target_cap, never through walls. A failed impact is not refunded.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

PvpParticipationState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Pvp participation state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
mode PvpMode Required Mode.
flag PvpFlagState Required Flag.
hostile_participation_until Instant | null Required Hostile participation until.
ruleset_id Id Required Ruleset id. Reference: PvpRulesetDefinition (content).
  • Faction hostility alone never authorizes attacks on unflagged players; heal assistance needs confirmation or explicit auto-flag setting.
  • Each accepted hostile action or confirmed eligible assistance sets hostile_participation_until to at least authoritative_now + ruleset.hostile_participation_seconds. The interval never shortens while active; normal-faction hostility alone never flags or targets another player.
  • Open-world unflagging requires expiry, out-of-combat state and no carried prohibited objective. Starter/protected areas always reject offense. Private timers do not disclose hidden source identities.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

ResolvedAbilityDefinition Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Resolved ability definition.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
ability_id Id Required Ability id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
content_version string Required Content version.
build_version Version Required Build version.
targeting AbilityTargetingPolicy Required Targeting.
timing AbilityTimingPolicy Required Timing.
costs array of ResolvedResourceCost Required Costs.
effects array of EffectOperationDefinition Required Effects.
bindings_resolved boolean Required Bindings resolved.
data_tests_passed boolean Required Data tests passed.
runtime_tests_passed boolean Required Runtime tests passed.
binding_id Id Required Exact content binding used to resolve this definition. Reference: AbilityRuntimeBinding (content).
  • Runtime requires all three readiness gates; profile presence alone is insufficient.
  • Resolve base → specialization → exclusive transform → additive families → declared multiplicative families → item effects → source buffs → PvP → clamps; recipient defense occurs on effect resolution.
  • bindings_resolved, data_tests_passed and runtime_tests_passed are independent evidence gates for the exact binding/build/content/rules tuple. All must be true before execution; authored fixture expectations alone do not set them true.
  • Separate certified runtime composition from AbilityDefinition, which preserves the prototype source record. No duplicate mutable ability definition is persisted.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: AbilityDefinition · AbilityRuntimeBinding · AbilityTargetingPolicy · AbilityTimingPolicy · EffectOperationDefinition · Id · ResolvedResourceCost · Version

resource_id ResourceType Required Resource id.

Authoritative skald signature history; shared resources, statuses, summons and debt are referenced rather than stored twice.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
maintained_song_ids set of Id Required Maintained song ids. Reference: MaintainedSongState (instance).
cadence_resource_id ResourceType Required Resource definition ID selecting this owner’s canonical ResourcePoolState; not a separate pool instance or balance.
  • 100 Cadence; Iron Verse +10 on contact; War Chant upkeep four/second, Thunderbeat cost 25, finisher 40; strongest-category group buff only.
  • The cited resource contract governs over inherited flavor labels. Pool IDs resolve the CharacterState resource map; marks/status/device IDs resolve shared runtime stores.
  • Sustained resource belongs to CharacterState; only signature-specific references and history live here.

StarcallerCombatState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Authoritative starcaller signature history; shared resources, statuses, summons and debt are referenced rather than stored twice.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
cycle_units integer Required Cycle units. {"minimum": -3, "maximum": 3}
  • Cycle meter −3 to +3; solar adds one, lunar subtracts one; eligible finisher consumes three units toward zero; no benefit from toggling a phase without a successful action.
  • CyclePhase derives from sign: negative lunar, zero neutral, positive solar. Phase changes never generate resources or events independently of the successful action.
  • The cited resource contract governs over inherited flavor labels. Pool IDs resolve the CharacterState resource map; marks/status/device IDs resolve shared runtime stores.
  • Sustained resource belongs to CharacterState; only signature-specific references and history live here.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

StatusInstance Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Status instance.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
instance_id Id Required Instance id.
status_id Id Required Status id. Reference: StatusDefinition (content).
source_entity_id Id Required Source entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
target_entity_id Id Required Target entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
owner_ability_id Id Required Owner ability id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
applied_at Instant Required Applied at.
expires_at Instant Required Expires at.
stacks Count Required Stacks.
source_power_snapshot CombatAmount Required Source power snapshot.
periodic PeriodicEffectSchedule Optional (may be absent) Periodic.
absorb AbsorbState Optional (may be absent) Absorb.
  • Resolve status_id through StatusDefinition. One instance per declared stacking key; do not duplicate source power or tick budget in class state.
  • Temporary group amplification is evaluated per tick, not snapshotted for the entire periodic lifetime.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

SummonCapacityState Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Summon capacity state.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
owner_entity_id Id Required Owner entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
summon_ids set of Id Required Summon ids. Reference: SummonState (instance).
capacity_limit Count Required Capacity limit.
aggregate_damage_budget CombatAmount Required Aggregate damage budget.
  • One four-unit owner capacity includes class and specialization summons. Lesser/static cost one; elite costs four; cosmetic zero. Sum active costs <= four.
  • specialized_mobile Bonewright costs two. Its replacement must free the replaced lesser before checking the final total; reject the operation if the resulting shared cost exceeds four.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

SupportContribution Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Support contribution.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
action_id Id Required Action id.
target_entity_id Id Required Target entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
actual_damage CombatAmount Required Actual damage.
incremental_support_damage CombatAmount Required Incremental support damage.
attributed array of AmountBySource Required Attributed.
accounting_policy "ordered_marginal_v1" Required Deterministic offensive-support attribution policy. {"const": "ordered_marginal_v1"}
  • Use ordered_marginal_v1. Keep the same root hit, critical outcome, non-support modifiers, mitigation, caps and rounding while adding eligible positive support modifiers in the existing modifier-family order, then stable (source_entity_id, owner_ability_id, status_instance_id) order within each family.
  • Credit each source only the nonnegative incremental effective damage produced at its step, aggregate once per source, and record unique sources in stable ID order. The baseline includes all non-support effects and negative modifiers.
  • Sum attributed amounts equals incremental_support_damage and cannot exceed actual_damage. Actual target damage is recorded once. This is deterministic accounting, not extra damage or a counterfactual team simulation.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: AmountBySource · CombatAmount · EntitySnapshot · Id

TargetSelection Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Accepted targeting intent with authoritative world scope attached by the server; target changes do not mutate an in-progress cast.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
mode TargetMode Required Authored targeting method.
entity_id Id | null Required Non-null for an entity-input cast; null for other input kinds. A cleared HUD selection is represented by null at its containing field. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
aim_point WorldPoint | null Required Ground placement intent when relevant.
aim_direction NonzeroDirection | null Required Nonzero finite direction when the resolved ability requires it; null otherwise.
  • Only the targeting inputs appropriate to the ability mode are valid. A mode-specific payload cannot silently retarget an existing cast.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: EntitySnapshot · Id · NonzeroDirection · TargetMode · WorldPoint

ThreatTable Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Threat table.

Responsibility: runtime state
Authority: owning world process

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
npc_entity_id Id Required Npc entity id. Reference: NpcState (instance).
threat_by_entity ID-keyed map of CombatAmount Required Threat by entity.
current_target_id Id | null Required Current target id.
forced_target_id Id | null Required Forced target id.
forced_until Instant | null Required Forced until.
  • One world-owned table per NPC. Leash clears it without rewards. Taunt only affects engaged eligible NPCs.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CombatAmount · Id · Instant · NpcState

ability_command_v2 Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Exact existing ability command name and example fields; owner and spatial scope derive from the authenticated world session.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
schema "ability_command_v2" Required Established wire-schema discriminator. {"const": "ability_command_v2"}
session_epoch Version Required Session epoch.
command_sequence Count Required Command sequence.
character_id Id Optional (may be absent) Optional consistency check against the authenticated session character; it never selects or authorizes another actor. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
ability_id Id Required Ability id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
build_version Version Required Build version.
content_version string Required Content version.
target_entity_id Id | null Required Target entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
aim_point Vector2 | null Required Absolute x/y point in the authenticated caster current zone, instance and floor; null unless required.
aim_direction NonzeroDirection | null Required Nonzero finite direction when the resolved ability requires it; null otherwise.
requested_charge_spend Count Optional (may be absent) Requested charge spend. {"minimum": 1}
  • The three intent keys are always present; unused inputs are null. Exactly the resolved AbilityTargetingPolicy.input_kind must be supplied. Missing, incompatible or ambiguous inputs are rejected; no implicit current-target or facing fallback.
  • Repeated (session_epoch, command_sequence) returns the prior acceptance/rejection/result reference. No damage, health, resource balance, random seed, position or cooldown completion from client.
  • requested_charge_spend applies only to declared charge spenders; Charge Lance spends 1..4 and requires sufficient available charges.
  • The server derives the actor and world scope from its authenticated session; a supplied character_id must match. Session epochs fence zone transfers. Coordinates are intent, never authoritative position.
  • requested_charge_spend is present only for a declared charge spender and is a positive integer; omitted means the ability declared default. Charge Lance requires 1..4 and sufficient unreserved charges.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: AbilityDefinition · CharacterRecord · Count · EntitySnapshot · Id · NonzeroDirection · Vector2 · Version

AbilityExecutionFixture Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Ability execution fixture.

Responsibility: test specification
Authority: content test author

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
fixture_id Id Required Fixture id.
command ability_command_v2 Required Command.
initial_state CharacterState Required Initial state.
expected_response CommandResponse Required Expected response.
expected_results array of CombatResult Required Expected results.
scenario FixtureScenarioKind Required The documented scenario family. {"enum": ["normal", "rejection", "invalid_target", "interruption", "retry", "resource_boundary", "pvp_control", "respec", "death", "disconnect", "transfer"]}
content_version string Required Content revision for all referenced definitions. {"minLength": 1}
rules_version string Required Formula/handler contract revision for these expectations. {"minLength": 1}
run_evidence FixtureRunEvidence Required Explicit unexecuted or actual executed evidence.
assertions array of FixtureAssertion Required Explicit timing/state/ownership checks. {"minItems": 1}
world_context FixtureWorldContext Required Exact clock, world and ownership preconditions.
steps array of FixtureStep Required Ordered timed follow-up inputs after the initial command at t=0.
  • Rejected/normal/interruption/retry/resource/PvP/respec/death/disconnect cases required before runtime-ready. No engine/gameplay implementation included.
  • world_context pins clock, collision content, initial visible entities/NPCs/groups and a server-test seed. Initial command executes at t=0; steps are nondecreasing origin-relative offsets. Explicitly repeat the same command sequence for retry tests; empty steps means no follow-up input. Server control events are fixture data only.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CharacterState · CombatResult · CommandResponse · FixtureAssertion · FixtureRunEvidence · FixtureScenarioKind · FixtureStep · FixtureWorldContext · Id · ability_command_v2

AbilityTargetingPolicy Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Ability targeting policy.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
mode TargetMode Required Existing authored TargetMode token; projectile travel remains an independent execution property.
relation TargetRelation Required Relation.
range_units CombatAmount Required Maximum placement or target range measured in authored world tile widths.
radius_units CombatAmount Required Area radius in the same world units; zero for an ability without an area.
target_cap integer Required Target cap. {"minimum": 1}
floor_policy_id Id Required Floor policy id.
line_of_sight_policy_id Id Required Line of sight policy id.
revalidate set of Id Required Unique authored target_revalidation checks to repeat at release; each must resolve to an allowlisted server check.
input_kind TargetInputKind Required The resolved content binding chooses the required input. The client does not select a targeting mode.
  • target_cap positive; policies must resolve to an allowlisted server handler. Prose revalidation_policy maps to authored checks; existing target_revalidation is preserved.
  • Every TargetMode has an explicit allowed input-kind branch. Pet/summon bindings choose exactly one supported kind per resolved ability; readiness fails if it is absent. Passive definitions cannot be activated by a client command.
  • Ground points are absolute x/y world coordinates within the authenticated caster current zone, instance and floor. The server attaches that scope; cross-floor and cross-instance point casting are unsupported in this revision.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CombatAmount · Id · TargetInputKind · TargetMode · TargetRelation

AbilityTimingPolicy Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Ability timing policy.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
cast_seconds Seconds Required Cast seconds.
channel_seconds Seconds Required Channel seconds.
global_cooldown boolean Required Global cooldown.
cooldown_family_id CooldownFamily Required Cooldown family id.
charges Count Required Charges.
recharge_seconds Seconds Required Recharge seconds.
commit_policy CastCommitPolicy Required Commit policy.
movement_allowed boolean Required Movement allowed.
haste_scaled boolean Required Haste scaled.
  • Instant actions commit together. Stationary casts cancel on movement unless an explicit talent window permits it. Cooldown reduction requires haste_scaled.
  • A nonzero channel_seconds selects channel_start_commit; otherwise release_commit. charges=0 means no charge store and recharge_seconds=0; a positive charge count requires positive recharge time. Ordinary instant costs/cooldowns commit together.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CastCommitPolicy · CooldownFamily · Count · Seconds

AccountRecoveryRequest Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Account recovery request.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
recovery_ticket string Required Recovery ticket. {"minLength": 1}
operation DurableRequestContext Required Idempotent recovery request scoped to the verified recovered account.
  • recovery_ticket is a one-use recovery-purpose proof from the trusted adapter. A successful receipt atomically revokes old sessions/epochs before fresh authentication; the proof cannot authorize an unrelated account.
  • Retries with the same verified account/operation return the prior receipt; consuming the same ticket under another operation fails. Recovery proof, request rates and lifetime come from explicit SecurityPolicy configuration.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

AdministrativePermissionPolicy Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Administrative permission policy.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
grants object Required Finite role grants; omitted roles deny all permissions.
realm_scopes ID-keyed map of set of Id Required Server-administered realm scopes for each role.
  • Default deny: omitted roles, empty grants/scopes and unknown permissions authorize no action. Assignments come from authenticated server administration, never from a gameplay request.
  • support has no mutation permission; moderator handles moderation/restrictions, game_master handles progression/inventory edits, economy_operator handles freezes/reversals, and release_operator handles restore. No wildcard role or inherited unrestricted administrator exists.
  • Check role, concrete realm/target scope and operation versions on every action, write an immutable AdministrativeActionRecord, and commit economic changes through the canonical receipt/ledger path.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

AppealRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Appeal record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
appeal_id Id Required Appeal id.
account_id Id Required Account id. Reference: AccountRecord (instance).
action_record_id Id Required Action record id. Reference: AdministrativeActionRecord (instance).
reason string Required Reason.
resolution string | null Required Resolution.
status string Required Explicit appeal lifecycle. {"enum": ["pending", "approved", "rejected"]}
reviewed_by_account_id Id | null Required Null while pending.
reviewed_at Instant | null Required Null while pending.
  • Pending appeals have null resolution/reviewer/time. Approved/rejected appeals require an authorized scoped reviewer, nonempty resolution and authoritative completion time.
  • Approving an appeal records a separate audited restriction/reversal action; it never erases original audit history or independently restores currency/items. Retention follows required deployment SecurityPolicy configuration.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

AttributeFormulaConfiguration Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Attribute formula configuration.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
rules_version string Required Required implementation formula revision covering caps, recovery, criticals, haste, mitigation and rounding; not merely the content package version.
base_attributes AttributeSet Required Base attributes.
power_base number Required Power base.
power_per_level number Required Power per level.
power_per_primary number Required Power per primary.
health_base number Required Health base.
health_per_level number Required Health per level.
health_per_stamina number Required Health per stamina.
tank_health_multiplier number Required Tank health multiplier.
mana_base number Required Mana base.
mana_per_level number Required Mana per level.
mana_per_intellect number Required Mana per intellect.
rating_scale_base number Required Rating scale base.
rating_scale_per_level number Required Rating scale per level.
defense_scale_base number Required Defense scale base.
defense_scale_per_attacker_level number Required Defense scale per attacker level.
primary_growth_per_level number Required Growth of the selected primary attribute, independently of which attribute is primary.
stamina_growth_per_level number Required Stamina growth per effective level.
other_growth_per_level number Required Growth of attributes that are neither primary nor Stamina.
  • This contract intentionally exports only the listed scalar coefficients. The rules_version selects the documented formulas, caps, recovery and rounding implementation; it must be recognized before loading this configuration.
  • A change to a fixed formula or cap requires a new rules_version and validation against guide/attributes.html. Additional configurable parameters require an explicit schema revision rather than an arbitrary dictionary.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

BackupManifest Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Backup manifest.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
backup_id Id Required Backup id.
created_at Instant Required Created at.
schema_version string Required Schema version.
content_version string Required Content version.
artifact_ids set of Id Required Artifact ids.
checksums ID-keyed map of string Required Checksums.
consistency_checkpoint_id Id Required One consistent inventory/wallet/ledger/receipt checkpoint captured with the backup.
checksum_algorithm "sha256" Required Artifact integrity digest algorithm. {"const": "sha256"}
  • Backup creation alone is not restore evidence; scope must include economically consistent items/ledger state.
  • Artifact IDs and checksum keys match exactly; every checksum is a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest. Record schema/content versions and one economic consistency checkpoint. Merely recording this manifest does not claim a successful restore.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

BuyerRequestRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Buyer request record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
request_id Id Required Request id.
buyer_character_id Id Required Buyer character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
realm_id Id Required Realm id.
faction_id Faction Required Faction id.
item_definition_id Id Required Item definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
remaining_quantity Count Required Remaining quantity.
unit_price CurrencyAmount Required Unit price.
expires_at Instant Required Expires at.
version Version Required Version.
state MarketOrderState Required State.
funding_reservation_id Id Required Canonical wallet reservation locking remaining_quantity times unit_price; not another balance. Reference: WalletReservationRecord (instance).
  • Accept a buyer request only after reserving its full quantity times unit_price from the authenticated buyer wallet. Currency stays in one canonical wallet reservation; a request owns no second mutable balance.
  • Each fill validates exact eligible item definition/binding/realm/faction, reduces reserved quantity and funds atomically, transfers the same item instance(s), credits the seller less the configured sale fee, and creates one durable delivery receipt.
  • Cancel/expiry releases only the unfilled reservation. A fill racing cancellation commits exactly one versioned result; retries return the stored receipt. Filling is fixed-price intent, not a client-authorized wallet debit.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CharacterRecord · Count · CurrencyAmount · Faction · Id · Instant · ItemDefinition · MarketOrderState · Version · WalletReservationRecord

CharacterAppearanceCatalog Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Character appearance catalog.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
race_id CharacterRace Required Race id.
options_by_category ID-keyed map of IdList Required Options by category.
compatibility_rule_ids set of Id Required Compatibility rule ids.
option_definitions array of AppearanceOptionDefinition Required Canonical option records for this race. {"minItems": 1}
required_categories set of AppearanceOptionCategory Required Categories this race catalog requires. {"minItems": 1}
compatibility_rules array of AppearanceCompatibilityRule Required Canonical compatible-option constraints. {"minItems": 0}
  • Map keys are AppearanceOptionCategory; actual art/options are content, not enums. Appearance cannot change combat capsule/reach/speed.
  • Option IDs are unique within the versioned race catalog. options_by_category and compatibility_rule_ids are validated indexes of the canonical option/rule records, not separate editable authorities. Required categories each have at least one real available option.
  • Creation submits exactly one valid option for each required category; optional categories may be absent. Randomize chooses only a compatible legal combination. A race change keeps valid shared selections and explains cleared incompatible selections. Cosmetic options never alter combat geometry.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

CharacterCreationRequest Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Character creation request.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
draft CharacterCreationSubmission Required Draft.
operation DurableRequestContext Required Creation idempotency key scoped to the authenticated account.
  • Validate faction/race/class, the selected race appearance catalog and naming policy; derive account, realm and starting progression server-side.
  • Claim the normalized name, create the character and starting records, and store the operation receipt atomically. A retry returns the same character or failure; reusing a key with different choices rejects as invalid payload. Never reserve a name independently of its committed character.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

Character naming policy.

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints

normalization_rule_id "display_nfc_key_nfkc_casefold_v1" Required Trim display input, normalize display to NFC; uniqueness key is NFKC plus Unicode casefold. {"const": "display_nfc_key_nfkc_casefold_v1"}
uniqueness_scope_id "realm_all_factions_v1" Required One uniqueness namespace across both factions within a realm. {"const": "realm_all_factions_v1"}
minimum_characters 2 Required Minimum Unicode code points after display normalization. {"const": 2}
maximum_characters 24 Required Maximum Unicode code points after display normalization. {"const": 24}
unicode_revision string Required Pinned Unicode-data revision used by both validation and key generation. {"minLength": 1}
reserved_name_keys set of string Required Explicit moderated/staff-name reservations. {"minItems": 0}
  • Trim outer whitespace, normalize display to NFC and validate 2..24 Unicode code points. Start/end with a letter; interior characters are letters, combining marks attached to a preceding letter/mark, or a single ASCII apostrophe/hyphen between letters. No digits, emoji, controls, internal spaces or adjacent separators.
  • Build the uniqueness key by NFKC normalization followed by Unicode casefold under the pinned unicode_revision. Compare across factions within the realm, including retained deleted-name reservations; release is an explicit durable operation.
  • The database uniquely claims (realm_id, normalized_name_key) in the character-creation transaction. Invalid/unavailable names preserve the draft. Reserved-name policy is content, never a client-side bypass or claim of legal clearance.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

CraftJobRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Craft job record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
job CraftJob Required Job.
recipe_content_version string Required Recipe content version.
result_receipt_id Id | null Required Result receipt id.
  • Stored state decides precommit release/resume and postcommit redelivery. No short offline craft continues without explicit asynchronous type.
  • Retain the accepted recipe_content_version and archive its material mappings/classification. Settlement creates immutable actual-consumption lineage; later recipe or mastery changes never reinterpret the original salvage basis.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

CraftSettlementRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Craft settlement record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
operation DurableContext Required Operation.
job_id Id Required Job id. Reference: CraftJob (instance).
quote_id Id Required Quote id. Reference: CraftQuote (instance).
consumed_inputs array of ItemQuantity Required Consumed inputs.
output_item_ids set of Id Required Output item ids. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).
customer_character_id Id Required Customer character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
crafter_character_id Id Required Crafter character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
commission CurrencyAmount Required Commission.
fee CurrencyAmount Required Fee.
profession_progress_units Count Required Profession progress units.
mastery MasteryBonusSnapshot Required Mastery.
receipt_id Id Required Receipt id. Reference: OperationReceipt (instance).
  • Consume/create/commission/fee/progress each exactly once in one transaction; total currency change equals negative fee. Mastery snapshot documents accepted result.
  • For salvage-eligible crafted output, commit checked material_provenance lineage with actual consumed quantities after mastery savings, recipe content/rules revisions and total output units in the same transaction. No client result or quote alone proves provenance.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

DuelRequest Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Duel request.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
command CommandContext Required Command.
target_character_id Id Required Target character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
consent boolean Required Consent.
action string Required Explicit consent/lifecycle operation. {"enum": ["invite", "accept", "decline", "surrender", "cancel"]}
duel_id Id | null Required Null only for a new invite.
  • Consensual duel only; no implied faction attack authority.
  • invite/accept requires consent=true; decline/surrender/cancel uses consent=false. accept/decline addresses an unexpired matching offer; surrender addresses an active participant; cancel before acceptance is inviter-owned. The session supplies the actor.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

EncounterCheckpoint Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Encounter checkpoint.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
encounter EncounterRuntimeState Required Encounter.
ownership_epoch Version Required Ownership epoch.
captured_at Instant Required Captured at.

EncounterTriggerDefinition Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Encounter trigger definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
condition_rule_id Id Required Condition rule id.
operation EffectOperationDefinition Required Operation.
phase_id Id | null Required Phase id.
condition EncounterCondition Required Complete finite activation condition.
maximum_activations Count Required Finite activation limit per encounter instance/phase. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
internal_cooldown_seconds Seconds Required Additional nonnegative delay between activations.
  • condition_rule_id is the stable content identity of the declared finite condition, not an arbitrary executable function. Conditions are evaluated server-side with persisted per-instance activation counts.
  • Only the bound operation runs, within the existing trigger depth/tick/child caps. Phase references must belong to the enclosing encounter; reset clears its hazards and trigger counters without awarding completion.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

Fishing catch definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
loot_table_id Id Required Loot table id. Reference: LootTableDefinition (content).

GatheringResponse Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Gathering response.

Responsibility: network response
Authority: gathering service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
outcome GatheringClaimOutcome Required Outcome.
receipt OperationReceipt | null Required Receipt.
findings array of ValidationFinding Required Findings.
  • Claimed requires committed receipt; losing empty node gives no output and consumes no materials/tool.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

GuildCommand Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Discriminated guild operations with exact payloads; client action intent never grants permission.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

  • Recheck authorization and optimistic versions transactionally; actor identity comes from the authenticated durable request. Permission fields are not accepted on invitation responses.
  • Currency and item withdrawal limits use the same canonical guild rank policy and committed transfer log; retries return prior receipts. Security deployment requirements remain tracked separately.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

GuildRankPolicy Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Guild rank policy.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
rank_id Id Required Rank id. Reference: GuildRank (instance).
permissions set of GuildPermission Required Permissions.
item_withdrawal_limit Count Required Item withdrawal limit.
currency_withdrawal_limit CurrencyAmount Required Currency withdrawal limit.
window_seconds Seconds Required Window seconds. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
  • Limits configured per rank; no undocumented amount/window defaults.
  • Withdrawal limits count committed nonreversed outgoing item units and currency over the rolling window_seconds before the transaction. Deposits and failed or retried requests do not consume or refill allowance. Rank changes do not reset recorded usage.
  • window_seconds must be positive. Item and currency limits are independent, per member within the guild; a zero limit permits no withdrawal of that kind.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: Count · CurrencyAmount · GuildPermission · GuildRank · Id · Seconds

Full machine-readable schema (includes nested shapes and nullability) 
{
  "type": "object",

InventoryOperationRequest Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Inventory operation request.

Responsibility: network request
Authority: authenticated client intent; server validates and derives actor

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
operation DurableRequestContext Required Operation.
transfer ItemTransferOperation Required Transfer.
items array of ItemQuantity Required Items. {"minItems": 1}
destination_container_id Id Required Destination container id. Reference: InventoryContainer (instance).
expected_destination_version Version Required Required destination container revision for every transfer.
slot EquipmentSlot Optional (may be absent) Requested equip slot; a two-handed main-hand assignment occupies both hands. Required only for equip or unequip.
expected_equipment_version Version Optional (may be absent) Required equipment revision for equip or unequip.
  • Actor and source owners derive from session; validate eligibility/versions and reserve atomically. No client-submitted result quantities or binding override.
  • equip requires the owner equipment destination, an eligible slot, quantity one and expected equipment/container/item versions. unequip requires the matching occupied slot and a personal bag with free capacity. Client intent cannot bypass binding, combat or reservation restrictions.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

ItemDefinition Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Existing ItemDefinition record format, preserving every field in the shipped corpus.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

  • Every material-kind item participating in economics resolves through exactly one explicit MaterialDefinition economic_policy. Binding and stack_limit agree; grade never determines common/rare/earned classification. Passive material records may omit effect; all existing effect encodings remain unchanged.
  • Requiredness follows the common fields in all shipped variants, with conditional variant rules added below. This documents the existing snapshot; prose intent does not execute.
  • Existing keys, representations and content values are preserved; this shape does not certify missing secondary behavior.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

ItemLineageRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Item lineage record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
item_id Id Required Item id. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).
operation DurableContext Required Operation.
recipe_id Id | null Required Recipe id. Reference: RecipeDefinition (content).
consumed_items array of ItemQuantity Required Consumed items.
previous_definition_id Id | null Required Previous definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
resulting_definition_id Id Required Resulting definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
previous_version Version | null Required Previous version.
resulting_version Version Required Resulting version.
removed_enhancement_ids set of Id Required Historical removed enhancement instances; no live ownership is implied. Reference: EnhancementInstance (instance).
retained_enhancement_ids set of Id Required Enhancements preserved only by declared recipe compatibility. Reference: EnhancementInstance (instance).
added_enhancement_ids set of Id Required Enhancement instances applied by this committed operation. Reference: EnhancementInstance (instance).
material_provenance CraftMaterialProvenance | null Optional (may be absent) Optional legacy field; null means no proved craft basis, never a safe zero-input craft. Required and nonnull for salvage.
  • Recraft preserves stable item ID and advances version; record old/new definition and enhancement decisions. Append-only provenance; not another item inventory.
  • The durable transactional owner records material_provenance atomically with original consumption and output creation, preserving archived recipe/mapping/rules facts after input destruction. It references the original basis on later item versions; no second mutable item ownership is introduced.
  • Missing or null basis keeps salvage disabled. Do not backfill from current recipes, equal IDs, names or the cheapest/most expensive alternate recipe; migrate only from retained authoritative original consumption evidence.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

Related contracts: CraftMaterialProvenance · DurableContext · EnhancementInstance · Id · ItemDefinition · ItemInstance · ItemQuantity · RecipeDefinition · Version

ItemOwnershipRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Item ownership record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
item_id Id Required Item id. Reference: ItemInstance (instance).
owner_account_id Id | null Required Explicitly no current value is permitted. Reference: AccountRecord (instance).
owner_character_id Id | null Required Owner character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
owner_guild_id Id | null Required Owner guild id. Reference: GuildRecord (instance).
container_id Id Required Container id. Reference: InventoryContainer (instance).
version Version Required Version.
reservation_id Id | null Required Reservation id.
  • Exactly one owner scope; guild-owned items may lack personal owner. Customer-bound escrow remains customer-owned. Reservation blocks competing operations.
  • No independently mutable copy in InventoryRecord, EquipmentSet, market listing or delivery. Item revision coordinates atomic ownership and instance changes.
  • Personal ownership requires account + character; guild ownership uses guild ID with null personal owner fields. Account-bound eligibility is checked through the personal account.
  • An equipped item belongs to the personal equipment container, never simultaneously to a bag. Container and slot-index updates share the ownership transaction and item revision.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: AccountRecord · CharacterRecord · GuildRecord · Id · InventoryContainer · ItemInstance · Version

LootRollResult Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Loot roll result.

Responsibility: network response
Authority: loot service; eligible participants

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
roll_id Id Required Roll id.
reservation_id Id Required Reservation id.
winner_character_id Id | null Required Winner character id.
receipt_id Id | null Required Receipt id. Reference: OperationReceipt (instance).
claimant_order set of Id Required Persisted uniformly shuffled claimant order; empty when all pass. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance). {"minItems": 0}
  • A nonempty claimant_order chooses its first character as winner; an empty order has null winner and receipt and consumes no item twice. Winner and durable delivery receipt commit atomically under the reservation/completion key.
  • A shared roll cannot change personal reward ownership, create another item, expose server drop tables or invalidate an already awarded full-bag delivery.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.

LootTableDefinition Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Loot table definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
entries array of LootEntry Required Entries.
selection_policy_id string Required Exact server-side selection algorithm. {"enum": ["all_guaranteed_v1", "independent_chance_v1", "weighted_one_v1"]}
selection_parameters 3 explicit variants (see full schema) Required Exactly the parameter shape selected by selection_policy_id.
  • Parameter-array length must equal entry count; weighted_one_v1 requires at least one entry. No probability or weight is inferred from item grade or rarity. Concrete drop rates are required content, not schema defaults.
  • The server records the selected result under a unique completion key before delivery. Retry/redelivery reuses that result and never rerolls. Ordinary instanced equipment uses personal ownership; only explicitly shared tables use the shared claimant policy.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

MarketFeeConfiguration Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Market fee configuration.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
sale_fee Fraction Required Sale fee.
listing_fee Fraction Required Listing fee.
minimum_listing_fee CurrencyAmount Required Minimum listing fee. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
listing_lifetime_seconds Seconds Required Listing lifetime seconds. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
active_listing_limit Count Required Active listing limit. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
  • All fields are required explicit configuration. Reviewed prototype defaults are 5% completed-sale fee, 0.5% listing fee with a one-minor-unit minimum, 48-hour listings and twenty active listings per character. These are tuning proposals, not validated balance or implicit schema defaults.
  • Listing fee is max(minimum_listing_fee, ceil(unit_price * listed_quantity * listing_fee)) and is charged once at acceptance. Sale fee is floor(completed_gross * sale_fee), capped by completed_gross, charged once per committed fill. Cancellation/expiry does not refund listing fees.
  • Reject zero/negative prices, stale versions and unaffordable fee quotes before listing. Fee policy/version is snapshotted at acceptance; retries use the original receipt and never charge twice.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

MatchRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Match record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
match_id Id Required Match id.
ruleset_id Id Required Ruleset id. Reference: PvpRulesetDefinition (content).
participants array of Id Required Participants.
result_reference Id | null Required Result reference.
outcome string Required Immutable terminal outcome when a match ends. {"enum": ["pending", "won", "draw", "cancelled"]}
winning_team_id Id | null Required Nonnull only for won.
  • Won/draw/cancelled corresponds to exactly one terminal match result. A win names an accepted team and durable result_reference; draw has null winner and a durable result_reference; cancellation grants no competitive rewards.
  • Persist terminal outcome, eligibility and grant keys atomically. Retry/reconnect references the same result and cannot create another match reward or overwrite its winner.

MatchRulesConfiguration Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Match rules configuration.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
ruleset_id Id Required Ruleset id. Reference: PvpRulesetDefinition (content).
team_size 5 Required First baseline has exactly five players per team; raid-sized variants require another ruleset revision. {"const": 5}
objective_definition_ids set of Id Required Objective definition ids.
phase_rules_id "objective_lifecycle_v1" Required Preparing -> active -> completed/cancelled; terminal phases never restart. {"const": "objective_lifecycle_v1"}
objective_rules ObjectiveMatchRules Required Same exact rules as the referenced PvP ruleset; no competing copy or override.
  • Exactly two equal five-player teams and one control_point_v1 objective. objective_rules must equal the referenced ruleset parameters; its copy is a validated accepted-rules snapshot, not a separately mutable source.
  • An uncontested living eligible team captures after capture_seconds. Opposing eligible presence contests and pauses capture; an empty point clears unfinished capture. Captured ownership changes only after a new uncontested capture.
  • Award score_per_tick each score_tick_seconds only while the owner has living eligible presence and the point is uncontested. First team to score_limit wins. At time_limit_seconds, higher score wins; equality is a draw. No implicit overtime or sudden-death phase.
  • Preparing validates teams, content, safe spawns and ruleset before starting time. Invalidated matches cancel with no competitive reward; deaths use protected respawn_seconds and normal shared control/normalization rules.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

MaterialDefinition Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Existing MaterialDefinition record format, preserving every field in the shipped corpus.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
band ProfessionBand Required Band.
binding ItemBindingState Required Binding.
family MaterialFamily Required Family.
id string Required Existing id.
name string Required Existing name.
source string Required Existing source.
stack_limit integer Required Existing stack limit.
economic_policy EconomicMaterialPolicy Optional (may be absent) Optional for reading legacy prototypes; complete policy is mandatory before any material economic route is enabled.
  • Preserve existing material IDs and their namespace. Resolve RecipeIngredient.material_id through economic_policy.item_definition_id for vendor, sellback, inventory and conversion nodes; equal strings/names never establish identity.
  • Absent economic_policy means unconfigured and keeps every affected economic route disabled. No class, identity, export eligibility or price is inferred for the existing catalog.
  • Requiredness follows the common fields in all shipped variants, with conditional variant rules added below. This documents the existing snapshot; prose intent does not execute.
  • Existing keys, representations and content values are preserved; this shape does not certify missing secondary behavior.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

Related contracts: EconomicMaterialPolicy · ItemBindingState · MaterialFamily · ProfessionBand
