PactClauseDefinition Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Pact clause definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
name string Required Name.
eligible_source_tags set of Id Required Eligible source tags. {"minItems": 1}
settlement_operations array of ClauseSettlementStep Required Ordered settlement steps sharing one authored total effect budget. {"minItems": 1}
route PactClauseRoute Required Required output family for this clause.
operations_by_progress object Required Explicit one-through-five progress budgets; no unstated scaling formula.
  • Clause choices are content records, not talent nodes. Ruin, Shelter and Silence identify damage, owner protection and enemy beneficial-magic disruption respectively. Selecting a clause grants none of the optional talent transformation bonuses.
  • One active clause and five progress. A successful paid root action contributes once, at most once per authoritative second; empty effects, self-damage, child effects and friendly summons do not qualify. Switching clauses clears progress.
  • Final Settlement requires the active clause and a valid marked enemy, consumes all current progress and executes one declared settlement budget. Ruin permits DAMAGE to selected_enemy, Shelter permits ABSORB to owner, Silence permits DISPEL of beneficial_magic on selected_enemy. No route silently changes the command target.
  • Each content record supplies exact operation parameters and scaling for each legal progress spend. A missing parameter or zero progress rejects settlement before commitment; progress cannot be spent twice on a retry.
  • Select operations_by_progress using the exact current progress count, then consume that count once. settlement_operations is the validated full-five-progress presentation/index copy and must equal operations_by_progress[5]; it is never a second independently mutable program.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
kind QuestObjectiveType Required Kind.
target_definition_id Id Required Target definition id.
required_count Count Required Required count. {"minimum": 1}
location_id Id | null Required Location id. Reference: WorldLocationDefinition (content).
  • Counts increase only from an authenticated successful matching root event while the quest is accepted. Deduplicate by quest/objective/root-event key and clamp to required_count.

QuestProgressRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Quest progress record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
quest_id Id Required Quest id. Reference: QuestDefinition (content).
status QuestStatus Required Status.
objectives ID-keyed map of Count Required Objectives.
version Version Required Version.
  • Counts keyed by QuestObjectiveDefinition ID. Quest content owns targets/counts; server owns credit. Persist current objective and completed tasks across reconnect.
  • Only accepted -> objectives_complete -> reward_committed transitions are supported by this baseline. Practice may repeat without moving completed reward state backward. Durable completion/grant keys prevent repeat XP, items or currency after retries and reconnects.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Quest reward definition.

Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
experience Count Required Experience.
items array of LootEntry Required Items.
currency CurrencyRewardDefinition | null Required Currency.

RecipeDefinition Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Existing RecipeDefinition record format, preserving every field in the shipped corpus.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
band ProfessionBand Required Band.
binding_result ItemBindingState Required Binding result.
commissionable boolean Required Existing commissionable.
craft_seconds Seconds Required Craft seconds.
customer_level_target Level Required Customer level target.
factions set of Faction Required Ordered collection.
grade ItemGrade Required Grade.
id string Required Existing id.
inputs array of RecipeIngredient Required Ordered collection.
name string Required Existing name.
output_item_id Id Required Existing output item id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
output_quantity integer Required Existing output quantity. {"minimum": 1}
profession_id Id Required Existing profession id. Reference: ProfessionDefinition (content).
quality_randomness boolean Required Existing quality randomness.
recipe_source RecipeSource Required Recipe source.
recipient_policy string Optional (may be absent) Existing recipient policy.
required_skill integer Required Existing required skill.
result_preview RecipeResultPreview Required Result preview.
station_required boolean Required Existing station required.
status string Required Existing status.
economic_route EconomicRoutePolicy Optional (may be absent) Mandatory declaration before enabling this recipe as an economic conversion, independent of recipe_source.
currency_cost CurrencyAmount Optional (may be absent) Explicit unavoidable NPC currency cost per recipe execution, including zero; player commissions are transfers, not a guaranteed currency source.
  • Economic admission requires economic_route and currency_cost plus all material mappings, complete positive input/output quantities, explicit binding/eligibility and supported deterministic execution. Missing values disable the route; recipe acquisition source does not establish output repeatability.
  • output_item_id resolves to ItemDefinition. A material output must have the unique reverse MaterialDefinition mapping. The complete graph accounts for every output_quantity and every authorized mastery configuration/remainder, not just base requirements.
  • Requiredness follows the common fields in all shipped variants, with conditional variant rules added below. This documents the existing snapshot; prose intent does not execute.
  • Existing keys, representations and content values are preserved; this shape does not certify missing secondary behavior.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

ReconnectSnapshot Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Reconnect snapshot.

Responsibility: network response
Authority: server; authenticated owning character only

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
ownership_epoch Version Required Ownership epoch.
server_tick Count Required Server tick.
location WorldPoint Required Location.
life_state CharacterLifeState Required Life state.
health CombatAmount Required Health.
stats DerivedCombatStats Required Stats.
resources array of ResourcePoolState Required Resources.
cooldowns array of CooldownState Required Cooldowns.
statuses array of StatusInstance Required Statuses.
build TalentBuildRecord Required Build.
summon_ids set of Id Required Summon ids. Reference: SummonState (instance).
damage_debt CombatAmount Required Damage debt.
visible_entities array of EntitySnapshot Required Visible entities.
  • Private owner view deliberately differs from public EntitySnapshot and server-only TransferCheckpoint; economic records obtained by transactional receipts.
  • Deliver only to the authenticated owner after epoch checks. Owner-private statuses may be restored; visible_entities is filtered independently using current visibility and never contains hidden source entities.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

RestoreRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Restore record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
restore_id Id Required Restore id.
backup_id Id Required Backup id.
administrator_action_id Id Required Administrator action id. Reference: AdministrativeActionRecord (instance).
reconciled_operation_ids set of Id Required Reconciled operation ids.
completed_at Instant | null Required Completed at.
findings array of ValidationFinding Required Findings.
integrity_status string Required Integrity and economic reconciliation evidence. {"enum": ["unverified", "verified", "failed"]}
  • Distinguish corruption recovery from reversing legitimate trades; never restore currency without corresponding item reconciliation.

SalvageRule Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Salvage rule.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
item_definition_id Id Required Item definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
common_material_returns array of RecipeIngredient Required Common material returns.
economic_route EconomicRoutePolicy Optional (may be absent) Required before enabling this salvage route.
provenance_policy "actual_consumption_per_unit_v1" Optional (may be absent) Required versioned salvage basis; missing policy disables salvage. {"const": "actual_consumption_per_unit_v1"}
gold_return CurrencyAmount Optional (may be absent) Explicit zero currency output, required for salvage admission. {"const": 0}
profession_progress_units Count Optional (may be absent) Explicit zero skill-progress output, required for salvage admission. {"const": 0}
  • Destroy original; return at most 25% original eligible common materials, zero rare/bound cores, zero skill XP and gold.
  • All four admission fields are required before activation although legacy prototype records remain structurally readable without them. common_material_returns is a complete explicit list of per-output-unit upper caps; an empty list is known no returns, never missing configuration.
  • Return entries have unique common material IDs and no must_be_customer_owned flag. Resolve every return through the one-to-one inventory mapping; reject rare/earned return declarations. Apply CraftMaterialProvenance actual-input/binding eligibility and its per-unit quarter bound; do not treat the cap as proof of original materials.
  • Missing/unknown provenance, unsupported source/version or starter export restriction rejects salvage. Destroy the selected units and commit bounded returns atomically once. Salvage grants zero gold and zero profession progress; no bonus yield or fractional carry applies.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

SecurityPolicy Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Security policy.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
request_rate_limits ID-keyed map of RateLimit Required Request rate limits.
payload_byte_limits ID-keyed map of Count Required Payload byte limits.
array_count_limits ID-keyed map of Count Required Array count limits.
permission_policy_id Id Required Permission policy id.
authentication_contract_id "opaque_service_ticket_v1" Required Trust one configured authentication adapter and consume scoped opaque one-use tickets. {"const": "opaque_service_ticket_v1"}
authentication_provider_id Id Required Server-configured trusted provider adapter; not selected by gameplay clients.
session_lifetime_seconds Seconds Required Positive maximum session lifetime. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
recovery_ticket_lifetime_seconds Seconds Required Positive one-use recovery-proof lifetime. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
transfer_token_lifetime_seconds Seconds Required Positive one-use destination-transfer lifetime. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
audit_retention_seconds Seconds Required Explicit positive operational audit retention; deployment must supply the value. {"exclusiveMinimum": 0}
rotation_policy_id "rotate_on_reauthentication_and_recovery_v1" Required Reauthentication and successful recovery revoke old credentials/epochs before issuing a fresh session. {"const": "rotate_on_reauthentication_and_recovery_v1"}
  • The configured trusted authentication service verifies credentials and recovery factors. Gameplay accepts only opaque purpose/account/audience-scoped one-use proof through the authenticated service channel; it does not implement or infer a password/credential format.
  • Every published request family has explicit rate, payload-byte and array-count limits. A missing limit disables that endpoint; a zero request count disables the family. Rate windows are positive and enforcement is independent of GCD.
  • Opaque session handles are server-validated, expiring and revocable. Login/recovery/logout/transfer checks enforce one owner epoch. A client-supplied role, account ID, consumed flag or expiry cannot grant authority.
  • Runtime provider selection, credentials, deployment values and retention implementation are later configuration. Secret tickets/tokens and unnecessary personal data never enter gameplay logs or public snapshots.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

StarterAreaConfiguration Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Starter area configuration.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
faction_id Faction Required Faction id.
zone_id Id Required Zone id. Reference: ZoneDefinition (content).
arrival_location_id Id Required Arrival location id. Reference: WorldLocationDefinition (content).
guide_npc_id Id Required Starter service NPC content. Reference: NpcDefinition (content).
vendor_npc_id Id Required Starter service NPC content. Reference: NpcDefinition (content).
recovery_point_id Id Required Recovery point id. Reference: RecoveryPointDefinition (content).
practice_encounter_ids set of Id Required Practice encounter ids. Reference: EncounterDefinition (content). {"minItems": 1}
tutorial_sequence_id Id Required Tutorial sequence id. Reference: TutorialSequenceDefinition (content).
final_challenge_ids set of Id Required Final challenge ids. Reference: EncounterDefinition (content). {"minItems": 1}
exit_transition_id Id Required Exit transition id. Reference: ZoneTransitionDefinition (content).
role_challenges object Required A required solo challenge reference for every role; final_challenge_ids is its validated distinct-ID index.
experience_validation_rule_id "required_solo_path_to_ten_v1" Required Compute required-path XP from canonical quests and guaranteed encounters. {"const": "required_solo_path_to_ten_v1"}
  • Faction-separated content uses mechanically equivalent objectives/rewards and protects arrival, hub and recovery locations from hostile player combat. Location, NPC, encounter, guide and transition references belong to the selected package/zone.
  • required_solo_path_to_ten_v1 sums one-time required quest rewards and guaranteed required encounter XP. From level-one zero XP, that sum must meet the existing level-ten progression threshold before the final role challenge. Optional tasks, profession activities and repeated practice contribute zero to this validation.
  • Each class can complete the path and its role challenge alone with existing unlock levels. All authored locations use valid zone/floor coordinates and safe recovery; guide and vendor references resolve to the advertised services. final_challenge_ids exactly indexes role_challenges.
  • Maps, NPC placements, localized guidance and numerical XP allocations are future content production. Their absence prevents a playable starter package, not completion of this parameterized contract.
  • The guaranteed encounter term uses the distinct required_encounter_ids from the tutorial stages and their completion_experience, each once. Optional encounter IDs and repeated kills are excluded; quest XP and encounter XP are distinct one-time grant keys.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

StatusDefinition Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Status definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
owner_ability_id Id Required Owner ability id. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
category StatusCategory Required Category.
duration_seconds Seconds Required Duration seconds.
periodic_interval_seconds Seconds | null Required Null for nonperiodic status; otherwise positive seconds.
maximum_stacks integer Required Maximum stacks. {"minimum": 1}
dispel_family DispelFamily | null Required Dispel family.
pvp_duration_seconds Seconds | null Required Pvp duration seconds.
refresh_policy StatusRefreshPolicy Required Refresh policy.
stacking_policy StatusStackingPolicy Required Stacking policy.
exclusivity_group_id Id | null Required Exclusivity group id.
persistence_policy StatusPersistencePolicy Required Persistence policy.
control_group_id Id | null Required Required for control statuses; null for other categories.
  • All fields are explicit. Null means nonperiodic, nondispellable, no PvP duration override or no exclusivity group as described by that property. Source entity belongs to StatusInstance.
  • The category matrix selects exactly one stacking and refresh rule. Periodic durations carry at most 30% of base duration and preserve the next scheduled tick; shield replacement uses the greater remaining/new budget.
  • Control uses the existing category caps, diminishing returns and rolling history. Stealth/concealment never reveal hidden source identities. Immunity declares its eligible effect family; it is not universal immunity.
  • The baseline dispel vocabulary is harmful_magic and beneficial_magic; null is explicitly nondispellable. Poison/disease flavor does not invent another automatic family. Healer role training selects harmful_magic; enemy beneficial dispel remains an explicitly granted ability.
  • Death/logout cleanup takes precedence over transfer checkpointing. Each enabled status must supply its concrete catalog record; category completeness does not supply art, coefficients or an executed handler.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

    "The category matrix selects exactly one stacking and refresh rule. Periodic durations carry at most 30% of base duration and preserve the next scheduled tick; shield replacement uses the greater remaining/new budget.",

StatusEffectEvent Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Status effect event.

Responsibility: network event
Authority: owning world process; filtered per recipient

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
event EventContext Required Event.
kind ReplicationEventKind Required Kind. {"enum": ["effect_applied", "effect_updated", "effect_removed"]}
target_entity_id Id Required Target entity id. Reference: EntitySnapshot (instance).
instance_id Id Required Instance id.
status_id Id | null Required Status id. Reference: StatusDefinition (content).
stacks Count | null Required Stacks.
expires_at Instant | null Required Expires at.
  • Only effect_applied/effect_updated/effect_removed. Initial visible state arrives via snapshots even when old events were missed.
  • Affected owners receive their own status display data. Other observers receive only explicitly public status display fields on visible targets; unsupported optional fields are null. Hidden-source identity is never included. A status is removed or redacted when authorization changes.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: Count · EntitySnapshot · EventContext · Id · Instant · ReplicationEventKind · StatusDefinition

StatusPersistencePolicy Existing · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Composable status cleanup flags; all choices are explicit and may apply together.

Responsibility: static lifecycle policy
Authority: versioned content package

Reclassified from Enum; original name and anchor preserved.

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
cleanup_on_death boolean Required Remove this status when its target dies.
cleanup_on_logout boolean Required Remove at authoritative logout after the disconnect grace policy completes.
checkpoint_for_transfer boolean Required Transfer the surviving authoritative instance rather than restarting its lifetime.
  • Death/logout cleanup takes precedence over transfer checkpointing. Checkpointing preserves expiry, next tick and remaining budget; it never restarts the status. A status not checkpointed is removed at transfer.
  • Member identifiers are a proposed symbolic vocabulary inferred from the documented alternatives; no serialized ordinal or string encoding is assigned.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

      "type": "boolean",

    },
    "checkpoint_for_transfer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Transfer the surviving authoritative instance rather than restarting its lifetime."
    }
  },

TalentModifierDefinition Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Talent modifier definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
talent_id Id Required Talent id. Reference: TalentNodeDefinition (content).
affected_ability_ids set of Id Required Affected ability ids. Reference: AbilityDefinition (content).
field_path string Required Finite supported path templates; effect_index selects one operation rather than arbitrary property traversal. {"enum": ["execution.cast_seconds", "execution.cooldown_seconds", "execution.mana_cost_percent", "execution.effects.power_coefficient", "execution.effects.weapon_coefficient", "execution.effects.power_coefficient_per_tick", "execution.effects.duration_seconds", "base_range", "radius", "target_cap", "replace_operation"]}
additive_family_id Id | null Required Additive family id.
multiplicative_family_id Id | null Required Multiplicative family id.
amount_per_rank number Required Amount per rank.
replacement_operation EffectOperationDefinition | null Required Replacement operation.
effect_index Count | null Required Required for an effects path or replacement; null for a top-level/timing path.
  • field_path must be allowlisted. Add same-family ranks before declared independent multiplication. Exact handler binding is required before enabling.
  • A scalar modifier selects exactly one declared additive or multiplicative family, a supported field_path and an existing operation index when needed. A replace_operation modifier has a nonnull typed replacement, zero scalar amount and null scalar families.
  • Per-path units and authored clamps come from the selected ability field. No generic JSON path, recursive expression or wildcard applies unrelated damage/heal/CC/resource budgets.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

TransferToken Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Transfer token.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
token_id Id Required Token id.
character_id Id Required Character id. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
source_epoch Version Required Source epoch.
destination_epoch Version Required Destination epoch.
destination_process_id Id Required Destination process id.
checkpoint_id Id Required Checkpoint id. Reference: TransferCheckpoint (instance).
consumed boolean Required Consumed.
schema "transfer_token_v1" Required Versioned message discriminator. {"const": "transfer_token_v1"}
issued_at Instant Required Authoritative transfer-proof issuance time.
expires_at Instant Required Authoritative one-use proof deadline.
  • Private server-side one-use lookup record bound to the exact character/checkpoint/source epoch/destination epoch/destination process. The handle is validated through the trusted service boundary; raw records are never public snapshots.
  • expires_at must be after issued_at and within configured transfer_token_lifetime_seconds. Destination epoch exceeds the source epoch; consuming/fencing the source is atomic. Expired, consumed, wrong-destination or stale-epoch proofs reject without creating a second owner.
  • The serialized consumed flag is audit state, never a client claim. A failed/expired transfer returns through the existing single-authority recovery path and does not undo committed economic operations.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Related contracts: CharacterRecord · Id · Instant · TransferCheckpoint · Version

Inspect canonical definition

Vendor offer definition.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
item_definition_id Id Required Item definition id. Reference: ItemDefinition (content).
quantity integer Required Quantity. {"minimum": 1}

economic_route EconomicRoutePolicy Optional (may be absent) Required explicit availability/outcome declaration before vendor purchase activation.
  • Explicit available vendor item/quantity/price. Crafted sellback < guaranteed NPC input purchase cost to prevent loops.

Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

VendorPricingConfiguration Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Vendor pricing configuration.

Responsibility: static content
Authority: versioned content package

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
id Id Required Id.
sellback_by_item ID-keyed map of CurrencyAmount Required Sellback by item.
repair_pricing_rule_id "proportional_missing_durability_v1" Required Versioned repair calculation. {"const": "proportional_missing_durability_v1"}
repair_pricing RepairPricingRule Required Complete repair quote formula parameters.
sellback_route EconomicRoutePolicy Optional (may be absent) Required declaration for configured vendor sellback edges; an explicit empty table has no sellback edges.
  • For positive missing durability, cost = max(minimum_nonzero_cost, ceil(purchase_value * full_repair_fraction * missing_percentage_points / 100)); an undamaged item costs zero. Every factor is server-quoted explicit content. Unknown purchase/repair value rejects a quote rather than treating it as zero.
  • Vendor sellback tables are explicit integer minor-unit values. Crafted sellback must stay below guaranteed NPC input purchase cost, and conversion graphs must conserve value after salvage. No NPC price is inferred from player market listings.
  • NPC repairs remain available; starter assistance is bound/nonexportable and cannot create tradable materials, salvage output or currency. Concrete per-item price tables remain future content production.
  • sellback_by_item keys resolve to ItemDefinition; values are minor units per individual item unit. Each enabled sellback requires an explicit entry (zero is valid when stated) and sellback_route. Absence is unavailable, not zero. Material entries resolve the same one-to-one mapping as buys and recipes.
  • Reject export-restricted starter supplies and all products derived from them for currency sellback. Existing binding/transfer eligibility still applies. No player-market quote supplies a guaranteed NPC price.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.
  • BW-002-T05 owner selections (2026-10-21): explicit identity, actual per-unit provenance and versioned route declarations. Economic metadata is optional only for legacy inspection; missing admission inputs disable affected routes. Native admission remains T06/T07; durable economic execution is later work.

WalletRecord Proposed · Fully Defined
Inspect canonical definition

Wallet record.

Responsibility: persistent record
Authority: durable transactional service

Property Type Presence Meaning / constraints
wallet_id Id Required Wallet id. Reference: WalletRecord (instance).
owner_character_id Id | null Required Explicitly no current value is permitted. Reference: CharacterRecord (instance).
balance CurrencyAmount Required Balance.
version Version Required Version.
owner_guild_id Id | null Required Guild owner when wallet is a guild bank; null for personal wallet. Reference: GuildRecord (instance).
  • Nonnegative integer minor units; debit/credit/fees/item movement commit atomically. WalletState is an authorized projection.
  • Exactly one of owner_character_id and owner_guild_id is non-null.
  • Available spendable funds equal balance minus all held WalletReservationRecord amounts. Every debit honors existing locks; reserve/consume/release atomically increments wallet revision and writes the durable operation receipt. A reservation owns a lock, never a second currency balance.
  • Field composition is a structural modeling inference from the linked requirements; no new gameplay behavior or balance is implied.
  • All associated feature pages and linked sections were cross-referenced for this definition; related contracts are listed in references.

Conventions and ownership

  • Canonical definitions live only in this registry. The generated schema bundle and HTML are read-only projections. Existing feature HTML and shipped data remain evidence, not alternate contract editors.
  • snake_case properties follow existing JSON and ability_command_v2. Existing mixed-case keys such as weapon_DPS are preserved for compatibility. Stable inventory IDs and anchors never change when classification changes.
  • Required means present; nullable permits explicit null. Optional fields may be absent. No implicit default exists. Empty collections mean a known empty set; null means no current selection or applicability as described per field.
  • Id is an opaque stable string, with a field-level x-reference naming its content definition or instance contract. Content references do not embed live entities. Entity IDs, account IDs, character IDs, item instance IDs and content IDs occupy different namespaces.
  • Numbers are finite. CombatAmount is measured in domain units with fixed-point thousandths, with final health rounding at resolution. Seconds are durations; Instant is an absolute authoritative timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC (explicit boundary representation; no existing epoch encoding is changed). WorldPoint includes zone, instance, floor and foot-anchor coordinates in authored tile widths.
  • Currency is integer minor units. No currency name, exchange rate, cap or new currency is introduced. Fractions are 0..1; fields explicitly named percent use 0..100. Existing formula coefficients retain their documented scale.
  • Arrays preserve order unless uniqueItems and set semantics are declared. Maps are keyed by the referenced stable ID. Runtime collections with unique entities use keyed maps or unique ID sets. No derived display owns a second mutable copy.
  • Enum encodings are explicit case-sensitive strings. Previously symbolic members serialize as their documented snake_case IDs; existing serialized labels and operation tokens retain their encodings. Never infer numeric ordinals. Unknown enum values or discriminators are rejected. Breaking changes require a new message discriminator and migration; compatible additions require a new package version and negotiated capability.
  • Static content is versioned by the package content version. Runtime state belongs to the owning world process; durable economic ownership belongs to the transactional service. Client requests carry intent and expected versions, never authoritative results.
  • A Fully Defined shape is supported at documentation level, not runtime-ready or balanced. Needs Decision schemas validate only their supported portion and cannot certify an unresolved mechanic. Text invariants require future semantic/runtime validation beyond structural JSON Schema.
  • Reviewed contracts and changed prototype descriptions ship as content package 2.1.0-design; registry format remains 2. ID namespaces are determined by the referenced contract, not a required text prefix, and IDs never authorize access. Session epochs and sequences must never wrap or be reused; acquire a fresh epoch before exhaustion.
  • A missing concrete map, art asset, deployed provider or executed gameplay test is future implementation/content work. It does not reopen a completed parameterized schema. All required configuration remains explicit; absent bindings/configuration keep future content disabled.

Identity, creation and progression

AccountRecord owns accounts; CharacterRecord owns character identity; CharacterProgressRecord owns earned progression; TalentBuildRecord owns applied selections. UI drafts and snapshots derive from them.

AccountRecord · CharacterRecord · CharacterState · CharacterCreationDraft · TalentBuildRecord · CharacterLoadout · RoleTrainingDefinition · QuestProgressRecord · TutorialProgressRecord

Combat, abilities and class state

World process owns resources, casts, statuses, threat, summons and debt. ResolvedAbilityDefinition composes the content profile with one applied build; all 37 specialization states reference shared pools, marks and schedules.

AbilityDefinition · ResolvedAbilityDefinition · ResourcePoolState · StatusInstance · PeriodicEffectSchedule · DamageLedger · SummonCapacityState · TriggerContext · CombatResult

Items, professions and economy

ItemOwnershipRecord and WalletRecord are durable truth. Inventory, equipment, escrow, listings and deliveries refer to the same instances. Craft acceptance snapshots mastery; settlements and outbox commit atomically.

ItemDefinition · ItemInstance · ItemOwnershipRecord · InventoryContainer · EquipmentSet · RecipeDefinition · CraftJob · CraftOrderRecord · MarketListingRecord · CurrencyLedgerRecord · OperationReceipt · TransactionalOutboxRecord

World, NPCs, quests and groups

Definitions own content; world instances own execution. Party membership and participation are snapshotted only when reward eligibility requires historical truth. Guild permissions reuse the transactional item path.

WorldLocationDefinition · NpcDefinition · NpcState · QuestDefinition · QuestProgressRecord · PartyState · GuildMembership · RewardEligibilitySnapshot · RewardGrantRecord

Network, persistence and operations

SessionOwnershipRecord fences one owner epoch. Requests never override domain authority. EntitySnapshot is a filtered public projection; reconnect and transfer checkpoints are private owner state. Economic receipts survive combat recovery.

SessionAuthority · SessionOwnershipRecord · ability_command_v2 · MovementIntent · EntitySnapshot · ReconnectSnapshot · TransferCheckpoint · TransferToken · AdministrativeActionRecord · ValidationReport

Sum already-rounded unit returns; never round an entire stack or carry salvage fractions.",

    "Trade and split preserve the basis. Merge only units with identical immutable provenance as well as existing stack attributes; different recipe executions/bases remain separate. No trade, split, merge or retry increases entitlement.",
    "Recraft, upgrade and enhancement events retain the original basis unchanged. Their additional inputs stay in their own audited consumed_items but do not enlarge salvage entitlement; the old item is never counted as new raw material. Noncrafted or legacy items without proved original consumption remain unsalvageable.",

Decision history and future work

0 open design questions; 30 resolved. Resolved decisions retain their anchors and reasoning. Future Briarwake content, implementation and execution evidence are listed separately below; they do not claim completed game code.

Resource terminology (resolved)

Review context: Several class and specialization labels differ from their resource contracts: Grace/Devotion, Soul Threshold/Soul Essence, Maelstrom/Stormcharge, Pact Shards/Authority, and Focus Windows/Aim. Confirm the eventual public terminology without creating duplicate meters.

Alternatives: Keep resource-contract labels and map legacy display aliases. / Rename public labels after content review.
Decision: Resolved: standardize public resource labels to Devotion, Soul Essence, Stormcharge, Authority and Aim, following the explicit resource contracts. Marksman Focus remains the separate sustained resource. Preserve stable IDs and one canonical pool per actual resource.
Impact: Legacy resource labels were renamed across class guidance, ability/talent catalogs, embedded character data and search. No gain, spend, cap or other resource behavior changed. Marksman accuracy behavior remains a separate open decision.

DemonologistCombatState · HighPriestCombatState · MarksmanCombatState · ResourceType · SoulreaperCombatState · StormcallerCombatState

  • classes/cleric.html#high_priest
  • classes/necromancer.html#soulreaper
  • classes/shaman.html#stormcaller
  • classes/warlock.html#demonologist
  • classes/ranger.html#marksman
  • guide/attributes.html#derived-values

Minstrel resource (resolved)

Review context: Minstrel resource contracts use Mana and Harmonies, while Balm Chorus and several talents still refer to Cadence spending or retention. Which references should eventually govern?

Alternatives: Mana sustains healing, Harmony is secondary; Cadence belongs only to performance. / Author explicit additional Cadence spending for named Minstrel actions.
Decision: Adopt Mana for sustained Minstrel healing and Harmony as its only specialization meter. Balm Chorus spends two Harmony; Encore of Mercy spends three. Cadence remains the performance resource. Clear Harmony modifies song duration; No Lost Notes reduces song Mana cost using its existing 2% per-rank coefficient.
Impact: Conflicting Minstrel ability and talent descriptions, embedded copies and class/catalog text agree with the existing three-unit Harmony contract. Runtime handlers still require the shared execution gates.

MaintainedSongState · MinstrelCombatState

  • classes/bard.html#minstrel
  • classes/bard.html#shared-class-abilities

Retired accuracy (resolved)

Review context: Ranger Prepared Retreat and Marksman Steady Distance still refer to accuracy, while the attribute rules and audit retire a random accuracy statistic. Clarify the intended non-random behavior before defining its state.

Alternatives: Replace remaining references with deterministic output/positioning modifiers. / Remove those talent effects.
Decision: Replace retired accuracy effects with explicit movement behavior: Prepared Retreat grants one mobile stationary ranged cast after Retreating Step; Steady Distance preserves the final Aim unit during movement.
Impact: No random hit statistic is introduced. Existing talent IDs, ranks and dependencies are preserved; the selected behavior still needs runtime tests before activation.

MarksmanCombatState

  • classes/ranger.html#talent.ranger.prepared_retreat
  • classes/ranger.html#talent.marksman.steady_distance
  • guide/attributes.html#critical-strikes-and-haste

Rarity grade (resolved)

Review context: Item grade has an explicit budget role; rarity color is mentioned separately without an authoritative rarity vocabulary. Decide whether ItemRarity remains a separate classification.

Alternatives: Keep rarity as separate optional presentation content with an authored vocabulary. / Use grade alone until rarity has a concrete purpose.
Decision: Use grade alone. Preserve ItemRarity as a documented compatibility alias of ItemGrade; do not add an independent rarity field or classification.
Impact: Item budgeting and acquisition use the existing four grade values. Presentation colors may derive from grade without a second multiplier.

ItemRarity

  • guide/items.html#explicit-item-budgets

Pact clauses (resolved)

Review context: Clause-based play is documented, but the authoritative clause set and distinction between clause choices and talent routes are unresolved.

Alternatives: Author a clause content catalog separate from talents. / Bind clause choices directly to existing talent transformations.
Decision: Use extensible clause records with explicit ruin/shelter/silence output families and targeted finite settlement steps. Talent transformations modify eligible authored clauses and never substitute talent IDs for clause content.
Impact: Documentation contract complete for Briarwake. Actual clause records, coefficients and handlers remain content/implementation deliverables; the contract no longer leaves the roster model or target semantics undecided.

PactClauseDefinition · PactClauseType

  • classes/warlock.html#pactbinder

Future implementation work:

  • Future Briarwake implementation: Author concrete clause content records under the documented ruin/shelter/silence routes, with eligible paid-action tags and exact operations for each of the five progress spends.
  • Future Briarwake implementation: Implement clause switching and settlement against the single canonical progress store; execute positive/exclusion fixtures before enabling those actions.

Guide dialogue (resolved)

Review context: The starter guide must introduce tasks and specialization, but authored story dialogue is deferred. Decide whether this needs a dedicated dialogue format or the existing interaction/tutorial contracts.

Alternatives: Use instruction/interaction references for the starter guide. / Author a separate branching-dialogue format later.
Decision: Use the existing instruction_ids and interaction_ids for starter guidance. Branching dialogue, authored narrative and conversation state are outside this contract.

New boundary encodings (resolved)

Review context: New symbolic enums, command discriminators, timestamps and identifier namespaces have no established serialized encoding. Which stable representations and compatibility rules will the first actual protocol/database adopt?

Alternatives: Explicit versioned string encodings consistent with current snake_case JSON. / Implementation-specific numeric tags with a published compatibility table.

Use explicit *_v1 discriminators for new boundary messages, RFC 3339 UTC Instant values and contract-typed opaque string IDs. ability_command_v2 retains its established discriminator.
